definitions: A thing that completes or brings to perfection a different thing.
The number or quantity of something, especially that required to make a group complete.
A word or phrase that completes the meaning of an expression, usually a verb, and is not an object.
A group of proteins in blood plasma and other body fluids that is activated by the presence of a pathogen and that contributes to the destruction of the pathogen.
examples: The wine was a perfect complement to the meal.
The ship has a complement of 200 sailors.
In 'She is happy', 'happy' is a complement.
The complement system plays a vital role in immunity.
